en.headline: Customs seizes 9kg cannabis buds in two airport cases; two arrested
en.dek: Officers found about 8kg in a Malaysian woman’s baggage from Bangkok on Saturday and 1kg in a Mainland man’s baggage from Bangkok on Sunday, with a combined estimated value of HK$1.8 million.
body: Hong Kong Customs detected two drug trafficking cases involving incoming air passengers at Hong Kong International Airport on Saturday and Sunday, seizing a total of about 9 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds with an estimated market value of about HK$1.8 million. Two passengers were arrested.

In the first case, a 33-year-old Malaysian woman arrived from Bangkok, Thailand, on Saturday. During customs clearance, officers found about 8kg of suspected cannabis buds inside her check-in baggage and arrested her.

In the second case, a 52-year-old Mainland man arrived from Bangkok on Sunday. Officers found about 1kg of suspected cannabis buds in his check-in baggage and arrested him. Both investigations remain ongoing.

Customs said it would continue to focus on passengers from high-risk regions and reminded the public not to participate in drug trafficking or carry unknown items for others. Trafficking in dangerous drugs carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment.

zh.headline: 海關機場連破兩宗行李藏毒案 檢9公斤大麻花拘兩人
zh.dek: 周六馬來西亞籍女子從曼谷抵港寄艙行李檢約8公斤懷疑大麻花；周日內地男子同樣從曼谷抵港檢約1公斤，合共市值約180萬元。
body: 香港海關昨日及今日在香港國際機場偵破兩宗涉及航空入境旅客的販毒案件，共檢獲約9公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約180萬元，兩名旅客被捕。
首宗案件中，一名33歲馬來西亞籍女旅客昨日從泰國曼谷飛抵本港。海關人員清關時在其寄艙行李內發現約8公斤懷疑大麻花，隨即拘捕她。
第二宗案件中，一名52歲內地男旅客今日從曼谷飛抵本港，寄艙行李被搜出約1公斤懷疑大麻花，亦被拘捕。兩宗案件仍在調查中。
海關表示會繼續根據風險管理原則重點揀選高風險地區旅客作清關檢查，並呼籲市民切勿貪圖金錢利益參與販毒，亦不要協助他人運送不明物品。根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物最高可判罰款500萬元及終身監禁。
